title: The Red Callender Trio and "Red Light"
summary: He recalls the trio with Willie McDaniel and Lucky Enois and the minor hit "Red Light" on Black and White.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I'm looking over some other things. There was the Red Callender Trio with Willie McDaniel, Lucky Enois, and I had a thing on there, "Red Light." That was on the Black-and-White label. "By the River St. Marie" and "Red Boogie". "Red Light" was a minor hit around town. Remember that? One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, Red Light, and then we'd go into the Blues, and Leonard Enois would sing some Blues choruses. That was kind of fun. That was a fun period.
